segments.exact:
"We ratified the async job contract: remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor. No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt."
segments.note: Reports a ratification and describes the resulting contract as settled fact; kept as one move since the enumeration (receipt speed, polling, no lost work) all serves describing the one ratified contract.
